author: A. B. Schroeder
title: Woodland Avenue School enrolled 73 Hispanic students for 2025-26
text:
Woodland Avenue School enrolled 73 Hispanic students in the 2025-26 school year, a 7.6% decrease from the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department shows.
The total student body at Woodland Avenue School for 2025-26 was 275. Hispanic students made up 26.5% of enrolled students, representing the second largest ethnic group at the school.
Located in the Hicksville Union Free School District, the school’s district offices are based in Hicksville.
Out of the district’s nine schools, Hicksville High School reported the highest Hispanic student enrollment at that time, totaling 758 students.
An analysis by World Population Review reported that New York’s public education system ranked second across the U.S. , though it ranked 31st for K-12 performance.
